gaps.why: cost_per_session is computable only on 72% of acme-bank. cost is only emitted on llm_call steps, which v2_flow lacks Reported with its denominator stated rather than blended.
no failover mechanism exists in the runtime, so no failover event is ever emitted. There is no primary/secondary path to observe.
gaps.why_the_proxy_misleads: but those are QUALITY retries at a different temperature, not failovers. Reporting them as failover would under-report and read as '0% failover', i.e. as good news.

gaps.why: session_end='abandoned' is MEASURED. WHY the user abandoned is a judgment about meaning and needs a versioned judged signal with a published calibration. Inferring it from the end code is a Rule 1 violation dressed up as an aggregate.
gaps.why_the_proxy_misleads: it counts everyone who left, including users who got their answer and simply stopped replying; the question is why
